reason: Observed third-set failures have correctly active factual cells but lose three token decisions to lexical competitors. Test one explicit contrast per diagnosed cell without changing selectors, gates or native compensation.
gate_source: late_selector_fact_gates; same directions and thresholds, no search or additional admitted cells. Actual states from all197 full-model histories.
scale_formula: Fixed first128 singular modes of the 1352 earlier native external normalized inputs after projection off the twenty-five carrier directions.
up_formula: Replace the ramp up-vector anchor by scale_readout/median_fit_rms. A saturated feature is approximately (reference/true_rms)*(read_scale/median_fit_rms), close to one rather than a varying squared anchor.
erasure_formula: Two neurons per carried coordinate use SiLU(z)-SiLU(-z)=z to subtract B*(P B)*(P scale_readout). The other output columns are orthogonal to B.
output_formula: Fixed rank128 native compensation on remaining features and one mean factual equation per valid cell, solved with the declared pseudoinverse. Targets are original residual plus the existing minimal-concept value, projected off B. No individual paraphrase output equation.
neutral_guard_states: A protected native position whose already observed next token equals this cell target is neutral, not negative. Unknown following tokens remain negative; no EOS target is introduced.
feature_rule: Exactly the first128 singular modes of the same3267 native remaining-MLP activations, whitened by their singular values. No rank search.
factual_null_formula: H=A_remaining V128/S128; J=mean_cell(F); C=mean_cell(H); G=H-F pinv(J) C. Thus every factual cell mean of G is zero.
native_margin_rule: For a changed native winner, restore its original raw margin against the current edited winner. For an unchanged winner, preserve its current raw margin against its current runner-up. One constraint per declared native guard; no new token labels or new EOS targets.
closed_form: Normalize each G row by its norm. K=(G G^T) elementwise*(M M^T), where M are unit decoder margin directions orthogonal to the25 carriers. lambda=pinv(K,rtol=1e-8) target; T=G^T diag(lambda) M. Apply T in remaining down columns and -pinv(J) C T in the46 fact columns. No iterations or line search.
equation_gate: Require relative mean-factual residual drift below1e-4 after F32. Report native constraint residual and decoder results without redefining them as whole-answer accuracy.
direction_rule: Unit normalized target decoder vector minus named competing decoder vector, projected orthogonally to the same25 carrier axes.
amplitude_rule: For each cell take the largest amplitude required to ADD four pre-edit RMS units of repetition-adjusted raw target-versus-rival margin on its earlier fit members. Same fixed margin4 as the earlier concept write; no amplitude search. Sign factors are read from the pre-edit logits, then actual decoding is checked.
fit_rule: Only existing earlier members of the three cells; no second or third state used to compute amplitude. Choice of cells and rivals is informed by the already observed third-set diagnosis.
weight_rule: Add the resulting vector to each chosen positive down column and subtract it from the two paired negative columns. Exactly nine down columns may differ from the source candidate; every other weight remains unchanged.
